description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git merge --abort' under various conditions, including conflicts, clean merges, and different repository states.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up a testing Git repository with multiple branches and files, simulating conflicts and clean states to test 'git merge --abort' functionality.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (unstarted merge)
methods.description: Tests that 'git merge --abort' fails when no merge is in progress and verifies output contains 'MERGE_HEAD' message.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (unstarted merge): .git/MERGE_HEAD sanity
methods.description: Checks that the MERGE_HEAD file is missing when no merge is in progress and that the commit hasn't changed.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (completed merge)
methods.description: Tests that aborting a completed merge fails appropriately and that the repository remains in its post-merge state.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (completed merge): .git/MERGE_HEAD sanity
methods.description: Sanity check to ensure MERGE_HEAD file is missing after a merge is completed successfully.

methods.name: Forget previous merge
methods.description: Resets the repository to a pre-merge state to prepare for further tests.

methods.name: Abort after --no-commit
methods.description: Tests aborting a merge that was initiated with --no-commit, ensuring the merge files are cleaned up and HEAD is restored.

methods.name: Abort after conflicts
methods.description: Creates a conflicting merge, then aborts it to verify cleanup and that the repository state is restored.

methods.name: Clean merge with dirty index fails
methods.description: Checks that a merge with a dirty index fails when it's a clean merge due to conflicts.

methods.name: Conflicting merge with dirty index fails
methods.description: Verifies that a conflicting merge fails when the index is dirty, and ensures rollback.

methods.name: Reset index (but preserve worktree changes)
methods.description: Resets the index to a previous state while keeping worktree modifications.

methods.name: Abort clean merge with non-conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests aborting a clean merge where the worktree has uncommitted changes, ensuring cleanup.

methods.name: Abort conflicting merge with non-conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests aborting a conflicting merge with uncommitted worktree changes.

methods.name: Reset worktree changes
methods.description: Restores the worktree to the previous commit to clear any test modifications.

methods.name: Fail clean merge with conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Checks that a clean merge fails if the worktree has conflicting changes.

methods.name: Fail conflicting merge with conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Checks that a conflicting merge fails if the worktree has conflicting changes.

methods.name: Reset worktree changes
methods.description: Restores worktree to previous state after conflict tests.

methods.name: Fail clean merge with matching dirty worktree
methods.description: Checks that a merge fails when the worktree contains changes that match the target branch.

methods.name: Fail conflicting merge with matching dirty worktree
methods.description: Checks that a conflicting merge fails with matching worktree changes.
